record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Can one find a criterion stated in terms of a grading-restricted vertex algebra itself that determines complete reducibility of its modules?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.3. Find a criterion on a grading-restricted vertex algebra itself for the complete reducibility of modules.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V = \bigoplus_{n \in \mathbb{Z}} V_{(n)}$ be a grading-restricted vertex algebra; that is, $V$ is a $\mathbb{Z}$-graded vector space equipped with a vacuum vector $\mathbf{1}$, an endomorphism $D$, and a vertex operator map $Y: V \otimes V \to V((x))$ satisfying the standard axioms (vacuum, $D$-derivative, and Jacobi/weak commutativity-associativity), and such that $\dim V_{(n)} < \infty$ for all $n$ and $V_{(n)} = 0$ for $n$ sufficiently negative. A grading-restricted generalized $V$-module is a $\mathbb{C}$-graded vector space $W = \bigoplus_{h \in \mathbb{C}} W_{[h]}$ with a vertex operator $Y_W: V \otimes W \to W((x))$ satisfying the module axioms, such that $\dim W_{[h]} < \infty$ and $W_{[h-n]} = 0$ for $n$ sufficiently large (depending on $h$). Say that $V$ has the complete reducibility property if every grading-restricted generalized $V$-module is a direct sum of irreducible grading-restricted $V$-modules.

Problem: Formulate a criterion, stated purely in terms of intrinsic structural data of the grading-restricted vertex algebra $V$ itself (and not in terms of properties verified on the category of its modules), that is equivalent to $V$ having the complete reducibility property.
artifact.status_search_result: Partial progress exists: Huang and Qi have developed a cohomological approach (using the first cohomology of grading-restricted vertex algebras with coefficients in bimodules) that yields complete-reducibility criteria under composability/finiteness hypotheses, and related work establishes complete reducibility under conditions such as $C_1$-cofiniteness. However, a fully intrinsic if-and-only-if criterion stated solely on $V$ itself appears not to have been established in full generality.

status_evidence.title: The first cohomology, derivations and the reductivity of a (meromorphic open-string) vertex algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Criterion for complete reducibility via cohomological condition for Z-graded V-bimodules generated by a grading-restricted subspace.
status_evidence.claim: A cohomological criterion (not yet fully intrinsic) for complete reducibility has been obtained under additional hypotheses.

status_evidence.title: C1-cofiniteness and vertex tensor categories (Y.-Z. Huang)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses C1-cofiniteness conditions on a grading-restricted vertex algebra and their consequences for module category structure.
status_evidence.claim: Intrinsic finiteness conditions on V are known to imply strong module-theoretic properties, but a complete-reducibility characterization remains partial.
